entities.summary: Vytautas Grubliauskas is a Lithuanian politician of the Social Democratic Party. He was elected member of the Seimas in the 2024 parliamentary election, having previously served from 2004 to 2011. From 2011 to 2023, he served as mayor of Klaipėda.
